# [0.1.0-alpha.1] Validate the local foundation

This is the first validation/continuation Issue for the source foundation produced before a real repository existed. Its creation does not assert prior GitHub tracking, owner acceptance or a successful Windows build.

## Goal and scope

Resolve the real dependency graph and validate the local Electron workbench plus the selected ChatGPT/GitHub/Codex workflow on Windows. Keep the current target for repairs of this unaccepted baseline. Record actual branch/HEAD once available; there is no invented basis SHA for the new product.

In scope: dependency compatibility/real lockfile, type/lint/build failures, focused regressions, actual desktop/owner smoke, effective agent settings, and observed evidence. Out of scope: real ChatGPT/Codex plugins, PTY, secret vault, arbitrary scripting, cloud services, installer publishing and final branding.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Node24/pnpm versions observed; dependency installation succeeds and the real `pnpm-lock.yaml` is committed through an authorized Git action.
- [ ] `pnpm doctor`, `pnpm check` and `pnpm test:desktop` actually pass with command/environment evidence.
- [ ] The owner performs relevant Windows journeys in `docs/development/testing.md`, including intentional editing, pointer resize/snap, cancel/save and panel modes.
- [ ] Invalid layout/storage/native-boundary negative cases remain covered; no security checks were disabled to make the application launch.
- [ ] Actual memory/CPU sample and workload are recorded without presenting fixture usage as future plugin performance.
- [ ] Codex project trust and requested/effective effort, sandbox and approvals are observed; no paid API/key or full-access assumption was added.
- [ ] The owner reviews the provisional collision/overflow/regional choices and identifies follow-up discussions without pretending items 12/16 were automatically approved.
- [ ] ChatGPT/owner accepts the delivered evidence; only explicitly authorized closure follows.

## Authorization

Issue creation authorizes only the requested metadata setup, not automatic source edits, commit, push, deployment or closure. The owner supplies the execution contract for subsequent work. Installation/setup commands in the documented first-run task are limited to this project's validation; network escalation is explicit and narrow.

## Evidence handling

Append actual findings, failures, fixes, commits, CI links and remaining manual steps to this live Issue. Keep the same Issue for continuations; do not maintain a parallel status or last-report file in Git. This seed file is a creation recipe, not the live state.
